Supports 0..N file attachments, free-form model + effort selection through the composer picker (Advanced > Model / Advanced > Effort), and a single tool toggle (web search, deep research, image gen, canvas, agent).

notes: Single canonical send workflow: continues a thread when chat_id is provided, starts a fresh chat when omitted. Supports 0..N attachments, model + effort selection, and a tool toggle.

Model and effort live behind the composer pill's Advanced panel: click the pill (labelled with the current effort, e.g. 'Pro'), expand 'Advanced', then open the 'Model' or 'Effort' row to get the option submenu. The workflow opens the panel once per selection, stamps the wanted option, and commits it with a trusted CDP click because ChatGPT drops synthetic clicks here.

model_slug and model_effort are free-form labels matched against whatever the account actually offers. Neither is hard-coded, so a renamed model or a plan without a Pro tier no longer breaks the workflow. When a label is missing the error lists every option the menu exposed, e.g. `model_not_found: wanted GPT-6; available=["GPT-5.6 Sol","GPT-5.5","o3"]`.

Rows are matched by label prefix (Model / Effort / Advanced), options by exact-then-prefix text match, and the pill is found by testid with a composer-scoped aria-haspopup fallback. That keeps the step alive across cosmetic markup churn.

Setting tool=image_gen triggers the inline image-generation toggle on the regular conversation surface; pair with chatgpt_images_download (passing the returned chat_id) when you want the generated images saved locally.
Multi-file upload uses ChatGPT’s existing #upload-files input directly (no need to click the +/photos menu first) and works because that input has multiple=true.
If a tool is missing from the top-level + menu, the workflow auto-expands the More submenu before failing.

parameters.attachment_file_paths: Zero or more absolute file paths to upload. Pass as a JSON array, a comma-separated string, or omit for no attachments.
parameters.chat_id: If present, continues this existing thread. If absent or empty, starts a fresh chat.
parameters.entry_url: Required direct URL. Use the saved full chat URL for continuation, otherwise the intended ChatGPT root or Project URL.
parameters.model_effort: Effort label exactly as it appears in Advanced > Effort (e.g. "Instant", "Medium", "High", "Extra High", "Pro"). Defaults to Pro.
parameters.model_slug: Model label exactly as it appears in Advanced > Model (e.g. "GPT-5.6 Sol", "GPT-5.5", "o3"). Defaults to GPT-5.6 Sol.
parameters.tool: Single tool toggle to enable before sending. Defaults to none.
parameters.model_version: Accepted for backwards compatibility and ignored. The version is part of the model label now (e.g. "GPT-5.6 Sol"), so use model_slug.
parameters.require_exact_model: Hard-fail when the applied model/effort does not match the request. Defaults to true; set false to send anyway and report what was applied.

help.summary: One workflow that sends a message to ChatGPT. New thread when chat_id is empty, continue thread when chat_id is set. Optional attachments (0..N), optional model/effort, optional tool toggle.

name: ChatGPT: Send

attachment_file_paths.description: Zero or more absolute file paths to upload. Pass as a JSON array, a comma-separated string, or omit for no attachments.

chat_id.description: If present, continues this existing thread. If absent or empty, starts a fresh chat.

entry_url.description: Required URL to open first. For a continuation this must be the saved full chat URL; for a fresh chat use the intended ChatGPT root or Project URL.

model_effort.description: Effort tier to select in Advanced > Effort. Free-form; matched against the labels the account actually offers (typically Instant, Medium, High, Extra High, Pro). Defaults to Pro. Fails with the list of available tiers when no match.

model_slug.description: Model label to select in Advanced > Model. Free-form; matched against the labels the account actually offers. Defaults to GPT-5.6 Sol. Fails with the list of available models when no match.

tool.description: Single tool toggle to enable before sending. Defaults to none.

project_id.description: Optional. Start the new chat inside this ChatGPT Project. Accepts a project gizmo id (g-p-...), its short_url (g-p-...-slug), or a full https://chatgpt.com/g/.../project URL. Ignored when chat_id is set (continuing an existing thread already keeps its project).

model_version.description: Accepted for backwards compatibility and ignored; the version now lives inside the model label. Use model_slug.

require_exact_model.description: Hard-fail when the verified model/effort does not match the request. Defaults to true.

steps.name: Verify the applied model + effort, run tool selection, stamp #upload-files
Upload 0..N attachments via the prepared #upload-files input (no-op when empty)
Let attachment chips render before we look for the send button

inputs.script: const cleanArg=(v)=>{const t=String(v==null?'':v).trim();return /^\{[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\}$/.test(t)?'':t;};const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const labelOf=(n)=>norm([n.getAttribute('aria-label')||'',n.getAttribute('title')||'',n.getAttribute('data-testid')||'',n.textContent||''].join(' '));const realClick=(n)=>{n.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});['pointerdown','mousedown','pointerup','mouseup','click'].forEach(evt=>n.dispatchEvent(new (evt.startsWith('pointer')?PointerEvent:MouseEvent)(evt,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0})));};const message=cleanArg(arg0);if(!message)throw new Error('message_text is required');const unavailable=(msg)=>({success:false,error_code:'MESSAGE_BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE',error_msg:msg});const chatId=cleanArg(arg1);window.__rzn_chatgpt_send_marker={pre_user_id:null,message_text:message,clicked_at:null};const captureActiveUser=async()=>{const session=await fetch('/api/auth/session',{credentials:'include'}).then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>({}));const token=session?.accessToken;if(!token)return unavailable('pre-send conversation auth unavailable');const headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Accept':'application/json'};const response=await fetch('/backend-api/conversation/'+encodeURIComponent(chatId),{headers});if(!response.ok)throw new Error('conversation API '+response.status);const conv=await response.json();const mapping=conv?.mapping;if(!mapping||!Object.keys(mapping).length)return unavailable('pre-send conversation mapping unavailable');const chain=[];const seen=new Set();let nodeId=conv.current_node||conv.current_node_id;while(nodeId){if(seen.has(nodeId))return unavailable('pre-send active chain contains a cycle');seen.add(nodeId);const node=mapping[nodeId];if(!node)return unavailable('pre-send active chain node '+nodeId+' missing from mapping');chain.push(nodeId);nodeId=node.parent||null;}const users=chain.reverse().filter((id)=>mapping[id]?.message?.author?.role==='user');if(!users.length)return unavailable('pre-send active chain has no user turn');const id=mapping[users[users.length-1]]?.message?.id||users[users.length-1];if(!id)return unavailable('pre-send active user turn has no stable id');window.__rzn_chatgpt_send_marker.pre_user_id=id;return null;};if(chatId){try{const failure=await captureActiveUser();if(failure)return failure;}catch(e){return unavailable('pre-send conversation boundary unavailable'+(e?.message?' ('+e.message+')':''));}}const findComposer=()=>{const el=document.querySelector('#prompt-textarea');if(el&&isVisible(el))return el;const pm=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div.ProseMirror[contenteditable=true], div[role=textbox][contenteditable=true]')).find(isVisible);if(pm)return pm;return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('textarea')).find(isVisible)||null;};const composer=findComposer();if(!composer)throw new Error('composer not found at submit time, InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,inputType:'insertText',data:message}));composer.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}else{composer.textContent=message;composer.dispatchEvent(new button[aria-label="Send prompt" i], button[aria-label="Send message" i]')).filter(isVisible);if(all.length)return all[0];const form=composer.closest('form');const scopes=[form,composer.parentElement,document].filter(Boolean);for(const scope of scopes){const candidates=Array.from(scope.querySelectorAll('button, [role=button]')).filter(isVisible).filter(b=>{const steps.name: Type the prompt into the ProseMirror composer and click send
Allow ChatGPT to create the conversation route (new chat) or update existing

inputs.script: const text=String(document.body?.innerText||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();if(/too many requests/i.test(text)&&/temporarily limited|wait a few minutes|requests too quickly/i.test(text))throw new Error('CHATGPT_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests');const unavailable=(msg)=>({success:false,error_code:'MESSAGE_BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE',error_msg:msg});const ctx=window.__rzn_chatgpt_picker||{};const m=location.pathname.match(/\/c\/([^/?#]+)/);const pm=location.pathname.match(/\/g\/(g-p-[^/?#]+)/);const chatId=m?m[1]:null;if(!chatId)return unavailable('conversation route was not resolved');const tfetch=async(url,opts,ms)=>{const c=new AbortController();const t=setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),ms||6000);try{return await fetch(url,Object.assign({credentials:'include',signal:c.signal},opts||{}));}finally{clearTimeout(t);}};const session=await tfetch('/api/auth/session',{},5000).then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>({}));const token=session?.accessToken;if(!token)return unavailable('no accessToken in /api/auth/session');const headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Accept':'application/json'};const load=async()=>tfetch('/backend-api/conversation/'+encodeURIComponent(chatId),{headers},6000).then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('conversation API '+r.status);return r.json();});const marker=window.__rzn_chatgpt_send_marker||{};const preId=marker.pre_user_id??null;const expectedText=String(marker.message_text||'');const clickedAt=Number(marker.clicked_at);if(!expectedText||!Number.isFinite(clickedAt))return unavailable('send marker unavailable');const userText=(message)=>(Array.isArray(message?.content?.parts)?message.content.parts:[]).filter(part=>typeof part==='string').join('\n\n');const normText=(v)=>String(v==null?'':v).replace(/\u00a0/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const expectedNorm=normText(marker.message_text||'');let conv=null,lastErr=null,resolvedMessageId=null;const deadline=Date.now()+20000;let attempt=0;while(!resolvedMessageId&&Date.now()<deadline){try{const candidate=await load();const candidateMapping=candidate?.mapping;if(!candidateMapping||!Object.keys(candidateMapping).length){lastErr=new Error('conversation mapping unavailable');}else{const chain=[];const seen=new Set();let nodeId=candidate.current_node||candidate.current_node_id;while(nodeId){if(seen.has(nodeId))throw new Error('active chain contains a cycle');seen.add(nodeId);const node=candidateMapping[nodeId];if(!node)throw new Error('active chain node '+nodeId+' missing from mapping');chain.push(nodeId);nodeId=node.parent||null;}const users=chain.reverse().filter((id)=>candidateMapping[id]?.message?.author?.role==='user');const candidateMessage=users.length?candidateMapping[users[users.length-1]]?.message:null;const candidateId=candidateMessage?.id||(users.length?users[users.length-1]:null);const advanced=!!candidateId&&(!preId||candidateId!==preId);const candidateTime=Number(candidateMessage?.create_time);const candidateNorm=normText(userText(candidateMessage));const matchesMarker=advanced&&candidateNorm===expectedNorm&&Number.isFinite(candidateTime)&&candidateTime>=clickedAt;if(matchesMarker){conv=candidate;resolvedMessageId=candidateId;}else lastErr=new Error(!candidateId?'active chain has no user turn':!advanced?'active user turn is unchanged from pre-send boundary':candidateNorm!==expectedNorm?'latest user turn text does not match send marker (expected '+expectedNorm.length+' chars starting "'+expectedNorm.slice(0,60)+'", saw '+candidateNorm.length+' chars starting "'+candidateNorm.slice(0,60)+'")':'latest user turn predates the send click (turn '+candidateTime+' < click '+clickedAt+')');}}catch(e){lastErr=e;}if(!resolvedMessageId){const wait=Math.min(2000,500*(++attempt));if(Date.now()+wait+700>=deadline)break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,wait));}}if(!resolvedMessageId)return unavailable('conversation mapping did not expose a new active user turn'+(lastErr?' ('+lastErr.message+')':''));const mapping=conv.mapping;const current=conv.current_node||conv.current_node_id;const chain=[];const seen=new Set();let nodeId=current;while(nodeId){if(seen.has(nodeId))return unavailable('active chain contains a cycle');seen.add(nodeId);const node=mapping[nodeId];if(!node)return unavailable('active chain node '+nodeId+' missing from mapping');chain.push(nodeId);nodeId=node.parent||null;}if(!chain.length)return unavailable('conversation API returned no active chain');chain.reverse();const userNodes=chain.filter((id)=>mapping[id]?.message?.author?.role==='user');if(!userNodes.length)return unavailable('active chain has no user turn');const submittedNodeId=userNodes[userNodes.length-1];const submitted=mapping[submittedNodeId]?.message;const submittedMessageId=submitted?.id||submittedNodeId;if(!submittedMessageId)return unavailable('active user turn has no stable id');return{url:location.href,chat_url:location.href,title:document.title,chat_id:chatId,project:pm?pm[1]:null,submitted_message_id:submittedMessageId,model_observed:ctx.desiredModel&&ctx.desiredEffort?ctx.desiredModel+' / '+ctx.desiredEffort:null,temporary_chat_active:new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('temporary-chat')==='true'};
